sections.label: Singapore Food Agency established
sections.summary: The Government established the Singapore Food Agency last year to ensure and secure a supply of safe food.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Government established the Singapore Food Agency (SFA) last year to ensure and secure a supply of safe food and it has done good work to improve sustainability of our food sources.

sections.label: Mandatory packaging reporting framework
sections.summary: The Ministry is implementing the mandatory packaging reporting framework this year to reduce packaging waste including plastics.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Ministry is implementing the mandatory packaging reporting framework this year, with the aim to reduce packaging waste including plastics.

sections.label: Food waste segregation requirements
sections.summary: The Ministry announced that owners and occupiers of commercial and industrial premises generating large amounts of food waste must segregate it for treatment from 2024.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Ministry had earlier announced that owners and occupiers of commercial and industrial premises which generate large amounts of food waste will be required to segregate their food waste for treatment from 2024.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Ministry share if the scope of affected premises and thresholds have been determined?

sections.label: Nee Soon South CC upgrade
sections.summary: Nee Soon South CC is being upgraded to a net-zero energy building, and the speaker hopes for bold national goals on green buildings.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My Nee Soon South CC is being upgraded to become a net-zero energy building.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I hope the Government will set bold national goals, to make it mandatory for high green coverage on new buildings or even to make them net-zero energy or energy-positive buildings.

sections.label: Green buildings and ground-up initiatives
sections.summary: Architects, planners and engineering professionals have produced green building projects, and ground-up sustainable initiatives exist, with the speaker intending to turn an MSCP rooftop into a community farm.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Since the rise in popularity of green buildings, many of our architects, planners and engineering professionals have risen to the occasion.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Their projects combining greenery and unique architecture have captured attention worldwide and even appeal to travellers for their "Instagram-worthy" appearances.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: There are also many ground-up initiatives, ranging from classes on making your own compost, to roundtable discussions, really free markets to exchange and give away unwanted items and so on.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In Nee Soon South, I intend to turn our under-utilised multi-storey carpark (MSCP) rooftop into high-tech community farm.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Singaporeans, especially the younger generation, are big on sustainable initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Government must take the lead and strike while the iron is hot.

sections.label: Singapore land carbon absorber to emitter
sections.summary: It was reported that land in Singapore changed from a net absorber of carbon in 2012 to a net emitter in 2014.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, it was reported that land in Singapore changed from a net absorber of carbon in 2012 to a net emitter in 2014.

sections.label: Singapore energy sector emissions and carbon tax
sections.summary: Singapore's energy and chemicals sector emits about 60% of total emissions; a $5 per tonne carbon tax applies for five years, reviewed by 2023 with intent to raise it to $10-$15 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Singapore's energy and chemicals industry sector contributes to about 60% of Singapore's total emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Government has set a carbon tax of $5 per tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent for five years and plans to review it by 2023 with the intention of raising the carbon text to between $10 and $15 per tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent by 2030.

sections.label: Carbon tax anniversary and emissions goals
sections.summary: One year after the carbon tax took effect, Senior Minister Teo announced goals to cap emissions by 2030, halve them by 2050, and reach net-zero.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, Sir, it has been one year since the carbon tax has come into effect and last Friday, Senior Minister Teo announced the goal of capping Singapore's greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, halving it by 2050, and eventually achieving net-zero emissions.

sections.label: UK net-zero 2050 target
sections.summary: In 2019 the UK set a target of net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, with policies and funding to support it.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In 2019, the UK set a new target of achieving net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, with ambitious policies and generous funding to support this.

sections.label: Nee Soon solar municipal electricity
sections.summary: In Nee Soon, 64% of electricity for municipal fittings comes from solar energy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In Nee Soon, 64% of the electricity for municipal fittings is from solar energy.

sections.label: Carbon tax review and Paris rate
sections.summary: The Ministry plans to review the tax only by 2023 and raise it to only $10-$15 by 2030, while the minimum rate for the Paris target is estimated at $54.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Ministry plans to review the tax only by 2023 and increase it to only $10 to $15 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The minimum rate required by 2020 to reach the Paris Agreement temperature target is estimated at $54.

sections.label: Company disclosures reduce emissions
sections.summary: The German Institute of Economic Research found company-level disclosures work, reducing emissions by 17% permanently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The German Institute of Economic Research has found that such company-level disclosures work, reducing emissions by 17% permanently.

sections.label: Nee Soon East Zero Waste Masterplan
sections.summary: Nee Soon East launched a Zero Waste Masterplan and has saved 39,792 disposables since April last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is at the core of everything we do.” Lastly, in Nee Soon East, we have launched our Zero Waste Masterplan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have saved 39,792 disposables – single-use plates, forks, spoons, bowls and cups – since the launch of our Masterplan in April last year.

sections.label: Kigali Amendment Refrigerant Reduction
sections.summary: The Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol aims to reduce hydrofluorocarbon refrigerants by over 80% in 30 years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol aims to reduce hydrofluorocarbon refrigerants by over 80% over the next 30 years.

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund investments
sections.summary: The question asks what immediate investments will be made from the initial $5 billion of the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund, what immediate investments will be made from the initial $5 billion?

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund
sections.summary: This Budget introduced the $5 billion Coastal and Flood Protection Fund amid projected sea level rise and beach loss.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: Researchers projected that 13.6% to 15.2% of global beaches will be lost by 2050.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: The Prime Minister shared at the 2019 National Day Rally that the UN currently projects that sea levels will rise by up to one metre by the end of this century, or 80 years from now.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: It was also shared that Singapore would need $100 billion or more over 100 years to build our coastal defences to protect ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: It is thus timely that this Budget introduced the $5 billion Coastal and Flood Protection Fund.

sections.label: PUB Stamford and Bukit Timah canals
sections.summary: PUB built the Stamford Diversion Canal and Stamford Detention Tank and upgraded the Bukit Timah First Diversion Canal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: PUB has undertaken significant infrastructure developments, including the construction of the Stamford Diversion Canal and the Stamford Detention Tank, to protect the Stamford catchment and the Orchard Road area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: There was also a $300 million seven-year-long upgrade of the Bukit Timah First Diversion Canal.

sections.label: Sea level rise coastal defences
sections.summary: Prime Minister Lee called sea level rise an existential issue, and at least $100 billion is committed to coastal defences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: At the National Day Rally in 2019, Prime Minister Lee mentioned that the sea level rise is an "existential issue".

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: We have committed at least $100 billion to build up coastal defences.

sections.label: Government expected spending
sections.summary: The Government expects to spend more than $100 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: The Government expects to spend more than $100 billion.

sections.label: DENV-3 dengue serotype threat
sections.summary: NEA noted the DENV-3 serotype threat, with rising cases in three large clusters and low herd immunity leaving Singaporeans vulnerable to a large outbreak.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In an update in January, NEA has noted the threat from the DENV-3 serotype, a strain of dengue not dominant in more than 30 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Dengue strains have, in the past, switched from DENV-1 and DENV-2, but NEA has noted a recent increase in DENV-3 cases in three large dengue clusters in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: While NEA has stated that it is still too early to say that there had been a switch of the dominant serotype, low herd immunity towards the new strain will leave Singaporeans vulnerable to a large outbreak.

sections.label: Dengue clusters reported by NEA
sections.summary: Last week, NEA reported 110 dengue clusters, of which 25 are at red alert level.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Last week, NEA reported 110 dengue clusters, of which 25 are at red alert level.

sections.label: Food waste in Singapore
sections.summary: In 2018, 763,000 tonnes of food was wasted in Singapore, a 30% increase compared to 10 years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: In 2018, 763,000 tonnes of food was wasted in Singapore, a 30% increase compared to 10 years ago.

sections.label: Diversifying food imports
sections.summary: The passage states that diversifying imports must be a strategic national security decision, even if less cost-effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Being mindful of the risks of over-dependence on any one particular supplier or region, we must make it a strategic national security decision to diversify our imports, even if it means that it may be less cost-effective.

sections.label: Food supply disruptions and 30-30 goal
sections.summary: The passage states potential food supply disruptions and that Singapore set a 30-30 goal to produce 30% of nutritional needs domestically by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Potential food supply disruptions could come from unexpected or extreme weather conditions, problems with transport routes or delivery modes, export bans, or even crises such as the COVID-19 outbreak.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Hence, diversification of our food import sources is critical and in addition, to enhance our food security, we have set for ourselves the "30-30" goal to produce 30% of our nutritional needs domestically by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Singapore currently produces less than 10% of her nutritional needs domestically.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: About 90% of our food needs come from over 160 countries.

sections.label: Singapore limited agricultural land
sections.summary: With only 1% of land mass allocated to agriculture, Singapore faces a big challenge in growing its own produce.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
sentences.text: With only 1% of land mass allocated to agriculture, we face a big challenge in growing our own produce.

sections.label: Domestic recycling failure rate
sections.summary: The speaker says domestic recycling is a failure, stuck at a dismal 21% to 22% rate.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: Chairman, I think I have mentioned this many times now, but we are a failure when it comes to domestic recycling, which is stuck at a dismal 21% to 22% rate.

sections.label: Packaging and plastic waste recycling
sections.summary: Of 1.6 million tonnes of domestic waste disposed in 2018, one-third was packaging, over half plastic, with only 4% of plastic waste recycled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Of the 1.6 million tonnes of domestic waste disposed of in 2018, one-third is made up of packaging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: More than half of this packaging is made of plastic, but only 4% of plastic waste is recycled.

sections.label: Plastic bag charge proposal
sections.summary: Noting plastic bag charges work elsewhere, the speaker asks if MEWR will consider a single-use bag charge for large and smaller retailers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Countries around the world have introduced a plastic bag charge, and it works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: It was estimated that every person was using 10 bags in the most recent year, compared with 140 bags in 2014 before the charge was introduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: For a start and similar to England, will MEWR consider introducing a single-use bag charge and make it mandatory for large retailers and optional for smaller businesses and waive the charge for single-use bags for fresh food and meat items?

sections.label: E-waste EPR scheme legislation
sections.summary: Last year this House legislated an EPR scheme for e-waste, envisioning licensed operators collecting and treating regulated consumer products for producers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad
sentences.text: Last year, this House legislated for an EPR scheme for e-waste.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad
sentences.text: It envisioned licensed operators collecting and treating regulated consumer products on behalf of producers.

sections.label: Mandatory Packaging Reporting Framework start
sections.summary: The Mandatory Packaging Reporting Framework will kick in on 1 July.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad
sentences.text: Next, on the topic of packaging waste, I note that the Mandatory Packaging Reporting Framework will kick in on 1 July.

sections.label: Food waste segregation requirement
sections.summary: Owners and occupiers of commercial and industrial premises generating large amounts of food waste must segregate it for treatment from 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohamed Irshad
sentences.text: Lastly, on the topic of food waste, the Ministry previously announced that owners and occupiers of commercial and industrial premises which generate large amounts of food waste will be required to segregate their food waste for treatment from 2024.

sections.label: Singapore e-waste generation
sections.summary: Singapore generates about 60,000 tonnes of e-waste a year, and the amount is expected to grow year on year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Singapore generates about 60,000 tonnes of e-waste a year and the amount is expected to grow year on year.

sections.label: Trays for dining cleanliness
sections.summary: A Member asks MEWR and NEA to promote tray usage while dining and to incentivise conservancy contractors to sterilise trays after each use.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: And one does not need to leave much to the imagination that the same food waste spat out onto tables ends up being smeared across the entire table.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I, therefore, ask that MEWR and NEA promote the usage of trays while dining and not remove the tray itself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This way, the tray catches any spillage as well as any food waste or oral fluids.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This means that conservancy contractors should also be incentivised to sterilise trays after each use.

sections.label: SEHC model improvements
sections.summary: Improvements to the Socially-Conscious Enterprise Hawker model include reviewed contractual terms, hawkers' feedback groups, a grant and a staggered rental scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Several improvements have been made to the Socially-Conscious Enterprise Hawker (SEHC) model to better support hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: These include a review of contractual terms between the operators and stallholders, regular hawkers' feedback groups, Productive Hawker Centres grant and a staggered rental scheme with lower initial costs for stallholders.

sections.label: New hawker centres plan
sections.summary: In 2011, the Government announced it intended to build 20 new hawker centres by 2027.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: In 2011, the Government had announced that it intended to build 20 new hawker centres by 2027.

sections.label: SEHC model since 2015
sections.summary: The new hawker centres have operated under the Socially-conscious Enterprise Hawker Centre model since 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If there is any, can the Ministry share the findings?

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: These new hawker centres have operated under the Socially-conscious Enterprise Hawker Centre (SEHC) model since 2015.

sections.label: Model reviewed and improved
sections.summary: The model was reviewed in 2018 and has been finetuned and improved after feedback from stakeholders and the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The model was reviewed in 2018 and there has been a number of finetuning and improvements since taking in the feedback from stakeholders and the public.

sections.label: Dengue cases surged
sections.summary: Last year, dengue cases in Singapore surged beyond 16,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: On vector control, last year, dengue cases in Singapore surged beyond 16,000.

sections.label: Warmer weather in Singapore
sections.summary: Singapore has seen warmer weather in recent years, especially in 2019, which was 0.9°C higher than the past average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Singapore has seen warmer weathers in recent years, especially in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: It was, I understand, 0.9°C higher than the past average.

sections.label: Project Wolbachia rolled out
sections.summary: Project Wolbachia was recently rolled out to help reduce the dengue mosquito population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Recently, Project Wolbachia was rolled out to help reduce the dengue mosquito population.

sections.label: Projected sea level rise
sections.summary: Scientists at the Centre for Climate Research Singapore project that by 2100 the mean sea level around Singapore may rise up to one metre.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Scientists in the Centre for Climate Research Singapore have projected that by 2100, end of the century, the mean sea level around Singapore may rise up to one metre.

sections.label: Enhanced Paris Agreement contribution
sections.summary: Senior Minister Teo Chee Hean announced Singapore will enhance its 2030 nationally determined contribution and submit a Long-Term Low Emissions Development Strategy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Last Friday, Senior Minister Teo Chee Hean announced that Singapore will enhance our 2030 nationally determined contribution to the Paris Agreement later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will also submit our Long-Term Low Emissions Development Strategy, which aspires to halve emissions from our peak to 33 million metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (MTCO2e) by 2050, with a view to achieve net zero emissions as soon as possible in the second half of the century.

sections.label: Carbon tax and emissions ambitions
sections.summary: Singapore will keep raising ambitions to limit and reduce carbon emissions, having implemented a carbon tax as Southeast Asia's first country.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But we will continue to raise our ambitions to limit and reduce carbon emissions over the long term, knowing well enough that it requires transformational change.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are already ahead of the pack by implementing the carbon tax last year – the first country in Southeast Asia to do so.

sections.label: Refrigerant training and HFC restrictions
sections.summary: NEA will train and certify refrigerant technicians, introduce a climate-friendly label, and from 2022 restrict supply of high global warming potential HFC equipment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Later this year, NEA will launch a training course to train and certify technicians to handle refrigerants properly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA will also introduce a voluntary climate-friendly label to help households identify refrigerators and air-conditioners that use alternative refrigerants with lower global warming potential.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: From 2022, we intend to restrict the supply of commercial water-cooled chillers and household refrigerators and air-conditioners that use HFCs with high global warming potential.

sections.label: MEES industrial energy savings
sections.summary: MEES will cut industrial facility energy consumption by at least 245 gigawatt hours annually, equivalent to removing over 20,000 cars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: MEES will reduce energy consumption in industrial facilities by at least 245 gigawatt hours (GWh) annually – equivalent to taking more than 20,000 cars off the road.

sections.label: PUB floating solar system
sections.summary: Next year PUB will deploy the world's largest single floating solar system of 60 mega-watt peak at Tengeh Reservoir.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Next year, PUB will deploy the world's largest single floating solar system of 60 mega-watt peak at Tengeh Reservoir.

sections.label: Government fleet vehicle purchases
sections.summary: From 2023, all new vehicle purchases for Government-owned fleets will be cleaner and greener where feasible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: From 2023, all new vehicle purchases for Government-owned fleets will be cleaner and greener where feasible.

sections.label: CVES and Early Turnover Scheme
sections.summary: Under the new CVES, the cleanest LGVs get a $30,000 incentive and the most polluting incur a $10,000 surcharge, with ETS enhanced from April 2021 to March 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Under the new CVES, the cleanest LGVs will receive a $30,000 incentive, while the most polluting LGVs will incur a $10,000 surcharge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To complement the CVES, we will enhance the Early Turnover Scheme (ETS) from 1 April 2021 until 31 March 2023, including expanding the scheme to cover Euro 4 diesel commercial vehicles.

sections.label: Coastal protection agency and fund
sections.summary: PUB will become the national Coastal Protection Agency from April, with a Coastal and Flood Protection Fund set up within PUB with $5 billion initial funding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Miss Cheng Li Hui and Mr Desmond Choo asked about our whole-of-nation strategy to coordinate coastal protection efforts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that PUB will assume the role of the national Coastal Protection Agency from April.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The investments to undertake coastal and flood protection could cost $100 billion over the next 50 to 100 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As announced by Deputy Prime Minister in the Budget speech, a Coastal and Flood Protection Fund will be set up within PUB, with an initial funding of $5 billion.

sections.label: Project Wolbachia mosquito suppression
sections.summary: Project Wolbachia trials achieved up to 90% suppression of Aedes aegypti in Yishun and Tampines, with NEA scaling up to five million male mosquitoes a week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: And I thank Mr Louis Ng for jointly spreading this message with us.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I am pleased to say that the Project Wolbachia trials have achieved up to 90% suppression of the Aedes aegypti population within the Yishun and Tampines test sites.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To do this, NEA has set up a hi-tech mosquito farm which optimises mosquito production, the sorting of male mosquitoes from females and the transportation of mosquitoes for release.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are scaling up the facility's production to five million male mosquitoes a week, over the next few years, to battle dengue.

sections.label: Singapore food import sources
sections.summary: Singapore's food imports come from over 170 countries and regions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Today, Singapore's food imports come from over 170 countries and regions.

sections.label: Local food production target
sections.summary: The vision is to locally produce 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs by 2030, up from less than 10% today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our vision is to locally produce 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs by 2030, but from less than 10% today.

sections.label: Technology and Lim Chu Kang farming
sections.summary: SFA is helping farmers adopt more technology and will study how the larger Lim Chu Kang agriculture area can be planned and redeveloped.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are helping them to adopt more technology and, with experience, we hope they can produce multiple times more vegetables than average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This year, SFA will study how the larger Lim Chu Kang agriculture area can be planned and redeveloped to enhance our food production.

sections.label: Sustainable fish farming study
sections.summary: SFA will study the expansion of sustainable fish farming, where applicable, in the deeper southern waters of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Besides the use of technology, SFA will study the expansion of sustainable fish farming, where applicable, in the deeper southern waters of Singapore.

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund support for farms
sections.summary: SFA committed $38 million from the Agriculture Productivity Fund over five years to support over 100 farms' productivity investments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Over the past five years, SFA has committed $38 million from the Agriculture Productivity Fund, or APF, to support more than 100 farms in their productivity-enhancing investments.

sections.label: Singapore Food Story R&D grant call
sections.summary: The first research grant call launched by SFA and A*STAR under the $144 million Singapore Food Story R&D Programme will facilitate this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The first research grant call launched by SFA and A*STAR last December under the $144 million Singapore Food Story R&D Programme will facilitate this.

sections.label: Novel foods pre-market assessment framework
sections.summary: SFA implemented a new regulatory framework requiring companies to seek approval and undergo scientific pre-market assessment before placing novel foods on the market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Last year, SFA implemented a new regulatory framework to require companies to seek its approval and undergo a scientific pre-market assessment before placing novel foods in the market.

sections.label: Unified licensing framework for food establishments
sections.summary: From 2021, SFA will introduce a single unified framework to license and recognise all food establishments, awarding longer licences and higher recognition for high standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: From 2021, SFA will also introduce a single unified framework to license and recognise all food establishments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: SFA will award a longer licence duration and a higher recognition to food establishments which uphold high food safety and hygiene standards.

sections.label: Legislation on food safety and donation
sections.summary: MEWR is working on legislation to enhance the food safety regime and is looking to introduce legislation to facilitate food donation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: MEWR is currently working on a legislation to enhance our food safety regime.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As part of this, we are looking to introduce a legislation to facilitate food donation.

sections.label: Climate-Friendly Household Package for HDB flats
sections.summary: The Government will introduce a $24.8 million Climate-Friendly Household Package to help households in 1- to 3-room HDB flats invest in energy and water-efficient models.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To help households living in 1- to 3-room HDB flats invest in energy and water-efficient models, the Government will introduce a $24.8 million Climate-Friendly Household Package.

sections.label: Household switch emissions and water savings
sections.summary: If all eligible households switch, emissions equal to about 12,600 cars can be cut and up to 400 million gallons of water saved yearly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: If all eligible households make the switch, we can collectively reduce emissions equivalent to taking around 12,600 cars off the road and save up to 400 million gallons of water annually.

sections.label: Workgroup on reducing disposables
sections.summary: Another Workgroup will be set up to reduce excessive use of disposables.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Another Workgroup on reducing the excessive use of disposables will also be set up.

sections.label: Transforming HDB towns into Eco Towns
sections.summary: Twenty years after Punggol became Singapore's first Eco Town, there is a vision to transform all HDB towns into Eco Towns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have come far in the last 20 years since the development of Punggol as Singapore's first Eco Town.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have a vision to transform all HDB towns into Eco Towns.

sections.label: Sustainability @ Tampines Park project
sections.summary: The first project, Sustainability @ Tampines Park, will be Singapore's first community-based circular eco-system for food production.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The first project, "Sustainability @ Tampines Park", will be Singapore's first community-based circular eco-system for food production.

sections.label: Singapore Eco Fund and SG Eco Office
sections.summary: The $50 million Singapore Eco Fund will be available later this year, and an SG Eco Office will co-ordinate sustainability projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Mr Mohamed Irshad and Mr Gan Thiam Poh asked for details of this fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are happy to announce that the $50 million Singapore Eco Fund will be made available later this year to the people, private and public sector, to support the co-creation of a sustainable Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: My Ministry will also set up an SG Eco Office to co-ordinate sustainability projects across Singapore.

sections.label: Zero Waste programmes engagement figures
sections.summary: Over 670,000 Singaporeans were engaged and almost 2,000 Zero Waste programmes and activities were organised with 3P partners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: To Mr Chen Show Mao's question, it has been a busy and successful year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We engaged more than 670,000 Singaporeans and together with our 3P (People, Public and Private) partners, organised almost 2,000 Zero Waste programmes and activities.

sections.label: Zero Waste Masterplan and target
sections.summary: Singapore charted its inaugural Zero Waste Masterplan and set a target to cut waste sent to Semakau Landfill by 30% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We also made tangible steps to lay the foundation for Singapore's transition to a circular economy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We charted out Singapore's inaugural Zero Waste Masterplan and set ourselves an ambitious target to reduce the amount of waste sent to Semakau Landfill by 30% by 2030.

sections.label: NEA NEWSand facility request
sections.summary: NEA will launch a Request for Information by mid-2020 for a commercial-scale facility to produce NEWSand.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Going forward, NEA will launch a Request for Information by mid-2020 for a commercial-scale facility to produce NEWSand.

sections.label: Reverse Vending Machines deployment
sections.summary: Eleven Reverse Vending Machines have been rolled out and 39 more will be deployed by mid-2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Eleven Reverse Vending Machines have been rolled out and we will deploy 39 more by mid-2020.

sections.label: Packaging data reporting regulations
sections.summary: Regulations will mandate reporting of packaging data and 3R plans by producers, retailers and supermarkets, with data collection from 1 July.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah, Dr Chia Shi-Lu and Mr Mohamed Irshad asked for our plans on this.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: This year, we will introduce regulations to mandate the reporting of packaging data and development of 3R plans by producers of packaged products, as well as retailers and supermarkets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Obligated companies will start collecting the data from 1 July this year, for submission to NEA early next year.

sections.label: Deposit Refund Scheme for beverage containers
sections.summary: In the first phase, a Deposit Refund Scheme for beverage containers will be implemented by 2022, building on reporting and vending machine trials.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In	the first phase, we will build upon the reporting framework and the Reverse Vending Machine trials to implement a Deposit Refund Scheme (DRS) for beverage containers by 2022.

sections.label: Studying DRS international practices
sections.summary: Norway and Germany achieved over 80% beverage container recycling with a DRS, and Singapore will study best practices and consult industry.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Countries like Norway and Germany have implemented a DRS and achieved high recycling rates of over 80% for beverage containers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We are studying international best practices and will conduct industry consultations and a Request for Information for the DRS later this year.

sections.label: Plastic waste recycling feedstock
sections.summary: The DRS will aggregate post-consumer plastic waste to supply feedstock and drive local recycling capabilities, with agencies engaging companies to set up mechanical recycling plants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The DRS will aggregate post-consumer plastic waste, such as PET beverage bottles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: This will supply a steady feedstock to drive demand for local recycling capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have been working closely with our economic agencies to	actively engage interested companies to set up mechanical recycling plants for post-consumer plastic waste here.

sections.label: NEWOil and e-waste EPR
sections.summary: Singapore is working with EDB on a pilot chemical recycling plant, and NEA has started registering e-waste producers and will tender for a PRS operator.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We hope that this will become – get ready for this – "NEWOil", and strengthen our resource resilience, just as we have done with NEWater and aim to do so with NEWSand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are working with EDB and industry partners to look into establishing a pilot chemical recycling plant that will contribute to and help anchor the chemical recycling value chain in Singapore within the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA has started registering producers under the e-waste EPR framework, which will take effect next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA will launch a tender this month to appoint the Producer Responsibility Scheme (PRS) operator, a key stakeholder in the e-waste EPR framework.

sections.label: E-waste facility processing capacity
sections.summary: The three new facilities will together process more than 50,000 tonnes of e-waste per year when fully operational.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Together, the three new facilities will be able to process more than 50,000 tonnes of e-waste per year when fully operational.

sections.label: Mandatory baseline cleaning standards
sections.summary: The Environmental Public Health Act will be amended to introduce mandatory baseline cleaning standards later this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To catalyse this transformation, we will amend the Environmental Public Health Act (EPHA) to introduce mandatory baseline cleaning standards later this year.

sections.label: Progressive implementation of cleaning standards
sections.summary: Standards will be calibrated to minimise compliance costs and progressively implemented from 2021, starting with higher-risk premises such as childcare centres, schools, eldercare facilities and hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will be mindful to calibrate the standards to minimise compliance costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will work with sectoral leads to progressively implement the new requirements from 2021, starting with higher-risk premises with high footfall and immuno-vulnerable occupants, such as childcare centres, schools, eldercare facilities and hawker centres.

sections.label: Reported dengue cases and deaths
sections.summary: In 2019, there were nearly 16,000 reported dengue cases, with 20 deaths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2019, there were nearly 16,000 reported dengue cases, with 20 deaths.

sections.label: New hawker centres by 2027
sections.summary: Of 20 new centres planned by 2027, seven are operating, with Bukit Canberra and Fernvale centres opening next.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of the 20 new centres we are planning to build by 2027, seven are already in operation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The next centres to open are Bukit Canberra Hawker Centre in end-2020, and Fernvale Hawker Centre and Market in early 2021.

sections.label: Hawker stallholder rental waivers
sections.summary: Under the Stabilisation and Support Package, stallholders in NEA-managed hawker centres get rental waivers, benefiting about 14,000 stallholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As part of the Stabilisation and Support Package announced during Budget 2020, we will provide a one-month rental waiver, with a minimum sum of	$200,	to	all	stallholders	in	hawker	centres managed by NEA or NEA-appointed operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Stallholders will receive 50% rental waiver this month, and 25% in April and May.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This will	benefit	about	14,000 cooked food	and market stallholders.

sections.label: Disbursement to cooked food stallholders
sections.summary: Close to $1.5 million has been disbursed to 526 cooked food stallholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Close to $1.5 million has been disbursed to 526 cooked food stallholders.

sections.label: Expanded HPG to market stalls
sections.summary: From 9 March 2020, the HPG expands to market stalls and supportable items broaden beyond kitchen automation to service innovation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: From 9 March 2020, we will expand the HPG to market stalls, and the scope of supportable items will be broadened beyond kitchen automation to include service innovation, such as queue management systems.

sections.label: Vocational training for ECOs
sections.summary: Enhanced vocational training will benefit about 2,600 ECOs with up-to-date skills in vector control, environmental sanitation and waste management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Enhanced vocational training will benefit approximately 2,600 ECOs by equipping them with up-to-date skills to better plan and implement a full array of measures including vector control, environmental sanitation and waste management.

sections.label: Training new and advanced FHOs
sections.summary: Over the next 10 years, 9,000 new and existing FHOs and 400 Advanced FHOs will be trained.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the next 10 years, 9,000 new and existing FHOs and 400 Advanced FHOs will be trained.

sections.label: Sponsorship and food science programme
sections.summary: Apollo Aquaculture offered to sponsor Germaine's full diploma, and SFA will work with NTU on a new post-grad certificate programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Recognising Germaine’s good work performance, Apollo Aquaculture has even offered to sponsor her for the full diploma.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This year, SFA will be working with NTU to launch a new Food Science and Technology post-grad certificate programme.

sections.label: Environmental services scholarships and e-waste jobs
sections.summary: NEA launched its first industry scholarship programme for 20 ITE and polytechnic students, and three e-waste facilities are expected to add 430 jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On the Environmental Services side, we have launched the first ever NEA-Industry Scholarship Programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will partner the industry to award 20 scholarships to ITE and Polytechnic students in related fields, such as engineering, environmental technology and sciences.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the recycling industry, the three upcoming e-waste recycling facilities are expected to add	another 430 jobs.

sections.label: Turning climate challenges into opportunities
sections.summary: Planning ahead and working together as SG United can turn climate change challenges into opportunities for companies to innovate and create jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: By planning ahead and working together as SG United, you can turn the challenges from climate change into opportunities for our companies to innovate and internationalise and create better jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Carbon tax review timeline
sections.summary: The climate issue is an existential threat and the carbon tax was introduced, but the review will take too long, with an increase committed by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: We agree that the climate issue, it is an existential threat and that is why we introduced the carbon tax.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: But the issue here is that we are going to take too long to review it, which is we have committed to increase it by 2030.

sections.label: German study on disclosure emissions
sections.summary: The German Institute of Economic Research showed that company level disclosure will result in a 17% reduction in carbon emission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: The example I raised in my cut is the German Institute of Economic Research that showed that this type of company level disclosure will result in a 17% reduction in carbon emission.

sections.label: Singapore's share of global emissions
sections.summary: Singapore's emission is barely 0.11% of the world's, about 50 mega tonnes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our emission is barely 0.11% of the world's – about 50 mega tonnes.

sections.label: Greenhouse gas commitments framework
sections.summary: The framework requires everyone to do their best within their constraints, and the solutions aim to meet GHG commitments including halving by 2050 and carbon neutrality in the second half of the century.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But the framework is one where everybody must do their best within the constraints of what they can do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: So, our solutions fit ourselves and we believe that with what we have put forth, including the time frame, we will be able to manage to achieve our GHG commitments including the new ones that Senior Minister Teo announced, to reduce it by half in 2050 and to being carbon neutral in the second half of the century.

sections.label: SGX sustainable reporting rules
sections.summary: SGX has required companies to do sustainable reporting, and they must comply or explain if they do not make sustainability efforts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Whether they will move faster with disclosure or not, I am not so sure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I will say though that our SGX has already made the right moves to require companies to do sustainable reporting and they have to comply or they have to explain, if they do not make sustainability efforts.

sections.label: Zero Waste Masterplan measures
sections.summary: The Zero Waste Masterplan aims to reduce waste sent to Semakau by 30% by 2030, with the Resource Sustainability Act enabling measures like e-waste EPR and a Deposit Returns Scheme in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Do we not need to reduce our waste signature even further?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We launched the Zero Waste Masterplan last year and one of the key goal, of course, is to reduce the amount of waste that we bring to Semakau by 30% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Zero Waste Masterplan lays out in details the initiatives that we will be implementing or are already doing in order to achieve this goal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Resource Sustainability Act has been passed and it is to enable some of these measures to be put in place.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, extended producer responsibility will be starting next year for e-waste.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Packaging waste is another one and we are actually bringing part of this EPR framework forward with the Deposit Returns Scheme that we will be implementing in 2022.

sections.label: NEWSand commercial facility
sections.summary: A commercial facility is being looked into for NEWSand to be used as construction materials.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The other one, of course, is NEWSand where we are already looking into having a commercial facility for NEWSand to be used as construction materials.

sections.label: Global solar energy costs
sections.summary: Solar energy costs have gone down all over the world, not just in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Solar energy costs have gone down all over the world, not just in Singapore.

sections.label: Reservoirs and solar panel costs
sections.summary: The reservoirs are the only large unused space, and solar panel costs are now low enough to benefit from economic gains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For us, the only large amount of space that is not used would be the reservoirs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: On the cost of solar panels alone, it is now low enough for us to benefit from the economic gains.

sections.label: SG Eco Fund rooftop farm
sections.summary: A Member says they will apply for the SG Eco Fund to get a rooftop community farm running this year, then withdraws an amendment and suspends the Sitting until 4.30 pm.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Definitely, I will be the first few who will apply for the SG Eco Fund as I want to make sure that our rooftop, high-tech community farm is up and running by this year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: With that, Sir, I beg leave to withdraw my amendment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 4.30 pm.
